defects.problem: Visible prose spells out D-flat rather than using the required accidental glyph.
defects.evidence: AUTHORING.md:10 requires ♯ ♭ ♮ for accidentals in prose. The score and Pearson analysis support the musical claim; this is typography only.
defects.fix: Use D♭ major / D♭-major as grammatically appropriate instead of D-flat major / D-flat-major.

defects.problem: The seven-word title exceeds LISTENING.md’s two-to-six-word cue-title range.
defects.evidence: LISTENING.md:51; the current title is The last sound is not a climax.
defects.fix: Use A quiet final resonance, or another concrete title of at most six words.

defects.where: dossier: session.date.note, carrier.catalogue.note, transfer.date.note, rights and source locators
defects.problem: Numerous prose words are accidentally joined to dates or identifiers, impairing the public dossier’s readability.
defects.evidence: Examples in this dossier include with1955, a1956, in1918, in1956, before1963 and former50-year. The underlying dates and provenance were independently checked.
defects.fix: Restore normal spaces throughout dossier prose, including words before years, month/year phrases and catalogue references. For example use with 1955, in 1956, before 1963 and former 50-year. Preserve exact machine identifiers, URLs, ISO dates and verbatim disputed matrix values.
